extend_action_space: extend the HabitatSimActions singleton to register a new custom action name and get its integer ID
has_action: check if a given action name is already registered in the HabitatSimActions singleton
get_action_value: get the integer value of a registered action by name using attribute or bracket access on HabitatSimActions
review_v0_action_space: review the HabitatSimV0ActionSpaceConfiguration class which defines stop, move forward, turn left, and turn right actions
review_v1_action_space: review the HabitatSimV1ActionSpaceConfiguration class which extends v0 with look up and look down actions
